Severity.description:
Whether a finding stops the import or is merely reported.

`BLOCKING` findings fail the freeze: nothing is written and the errors go
back to the analyst (mvp-spec.md §4.3, sw-design.md §6.3.1).
`REPORTED` findings are collected into the import report and shown, but the
corpus is still created.
Severity.title: Severity

TypeHint.description:

The `Ausw`/`Feld` suffix rule runs **first**; value-shape inspection only
decides what the suffix leaves open. An `Ausw` column is `ENUM` even when
every value happens to look like an integer.

post.description:
A frozen set only — the design's "Clone to new evaluation." 422 (same
`FeatureValidationErrorResponse` shape as `freeze`) when the source is
still a draft (`FEATURE_ERROR_CLONE_OF_DRAFT`).

Validation problems surface as error rows on the response; only
`freeze` blocks on them (mvp-spec.md §7/§8.2).

422 with every blocking error and creates nothing (mirrors J2's
corpus-freeze contract). 409 when the set is already frozen.
